description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Phobos Shadow Force (WP-M2a). Fixture sm11e_m2a_marines_active. Setup privileges: P2 at 0 CP, a dense ruin under the Infiltrators (injected into TerrainManager — the fixture board is open). Shooting phase: (1) the Infiltrators (PHOBOS) shoot the Gretchin: shooting would stop them being hidden; the unit_has_shot window shows the free SHADOW MASTERS card with two buttons; a REAL click on 'Stay hidden' — they are hidden again (Game Log). (2) The Lieutenant with Combi-weapon (EXECUTE AND REDEPLOY) shoots: the card offers a 6" normal move; a REAL click on Use starts the move (the reactive-move panel); it moves 3" north (the panel's drag + Confirm) and is not eligible to charge this turn.
